group: lockstep-mode3 (MoltPetit/Model/KeyStealingLockstep.lean + LOCKSTEP_DESIGN.md, with the imported surface it consumes)

modules.purpose: Mode 3 free-cadence lockstep rotation, D1'-thin: a schedule-free validator (signatures + validChainK + no-mixing), an execution-level behavioural roster counter rosterGen packaged in LockstepPackage, the pinning theorem (matured windows declare exactly rosterGen), and a lagged-schedule transport (lagSched n rosterGen = fun s => rosterGen (s/n - 1)) that makes every accepted lockstep chain pass validSignedChainSched, so PackageA's scheduled theorem set is inherited. 614 lines, namespace MoltPetit.Model, no `open`, proofs use `classical` tactic. Budget is the CUMULATIVE exposedBound at lagSched (PackageA's shape); the per-generation census (erasure_freeze load-bearing) is explicitly NOT delivered.

defs.name: lockstepOk
defs.signature: def lockstepOk (n : Nat) : Chain → Bool | [] => true | b :: rest => rest.all (fun b' => decide ((b.slot / n = b'.slot / n → b.keyIndex = b'.keyIndex) ∧ b.keyIndex ≤ b'.keyIndex)) && lockstepOk n rest
defs.meaning: The no-mixing rule: keyIndex constant within each n-slot window (slot / n) and non-decreasing along the chain; compares ALL pairs (roster-wide), unlike keyMonoOk which compares only same-producer pairs.

defs.name: validSignedChainLock
defs.signature: def validSignedChainLock {σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (ops : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (sc : SignedChain σ) : Bool := sigsOk n ops registry sc && validChainK n (stripSigs sc) && lockstepOk n (stripSigs sc)
defs.meaning: The lockstep signed validator: versioned-registry signatures at the DECLARED keyIndex (sigOk), full indexed validity (validChain Bool + keyMonoOk), and no-mixing. No schedule parameter anywhere.

defs.name: lagSched
defs.signature: def lagSched (n : Nat) (rosterGen : Nat → Nat) (s : Nat) : Nat := rosterGen (s / n - 1)
defs.meaning: One-window-lagged schedule induced by rosterGen; Nat subtraction makes window 0 lag to itself (0 - 1 = 0), pinned by genesis_gen. This is the schedule at which every scheduled theorem is instantiated for lockstep chains.

defs.name: LockstepPackage
defs.signature:
structure LockstepPackage (n : Nat) (rosterGen : Nat → Nat) {Sig sk pk : Type} (ops : SigOps Sig sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (rented : ByzantineSlots) (Stolen : Nat → Nat → Prop) (honestSigned : Nat → Nat → Option Block) (now Δ : Nat) (G : Block) (R T : Nat) : Prop where
  mono : ∀ ⦃w w' : Nat⦄, w ≤ w' → rosterGen w ≤ rosterGen w'
  unforgeable : SchedCoreUnforgeable n (fun _ => 0) ops registry rented Stolen honestSigned now Δ
  declared : ∀ ⦃i s : Nat⦄ ⦃B : Block⦄, honestSigned i s = some B → B.keyIndex = rosterGen (s / n)
  hashInj : SignedHashInjective (SignedDeclared n ops registry) G
  genesis_gen : G.keyIndex = rosterGen (G.slot / n)
  rentBound : ∀ u, (badSlotsIn rented u n).card ≤ R
  exposedBound : ∀ u, (exposedProducersSched n (lagSched n rosterGen) Stolen u).card ≤ T
  budget_le : R + T ≤ maxByzantine n
defs.meaning: Field meanings: `mono` = rosterGen is monotone per window (B1 as behaviour; NOT consumed by any proof in this module — chain-level monotonicity from lockstepOk is used instead); `unforgeable` = registry EUF-CMA surface at the WEAKEST core validator (constant-0 schedule, pin vacuous) so its scope covers lockstep-accepted chains without circularity (audit obstruction 3); `declared` = every honest signature (entry of honestSigned) declares its window's rosterGen — the genuinely new coordination hypothesis; `hashInj` = collision resistance on the declared-signed-or-genesis domain (consumed only via toPackageA by the scheduled engine); `genesis_gen` = genesis declares its own window's rosterGen (pins window 0, needed because lagSched lags window 0 to itself); `rentBound` = ≤ R rented slots per any n-window; `exposedBound` = ≤ T exposed producers per window at the LAGGED schedule — cumulative census: theftSched n (lagSched n rosterGen) Stolen s = ∃ j, rosterGen (s/n - 1) ≤ j ∧ Stolen (s % n) j; `budget_le` = R + T ≤ ⌊(n-1)/3⌋. Assumption-wise = PackageA at lagSched + {mono, declared, genesis_gen}.

defs.name: lockstep_rel
defs.signature: private theorem lockstep_rel {n : Nat} {c : Chain} (hS : StrictSlots c) (hLock : lockstepOk n c = true) {A B : Block} (hA : A ∈ c) (hB : B ∈ c) (hAB : A.slot < B.slot) : (A.slot / n = B.slot / n → A.keyIndex = B.keyIndex) ∧ A.keyIndex ≤ B.keyIndex
defs.meaning: Slot-ordered pair of chain members satisfy the no-mixing relation. Private; a new module must re-prove (via lockstepOk_iff_pairwise + List.pairwise_iff_getElem + exists_blockAt_of_mem + strictSlots_lt).

defs.name: lockstep_const
defs.signature: private theorem lockstep_const {n : Nat} {c : Chain} (hS : StrictSlots c) (hLock : lockstepOk n c = true) {A B : Block} (hA : A ∈ c) (hB : B ∈ c) (hw : A.slot / n = B.slot / n) : A.keyIndex = B.keyIndex
defs.meaning: Same-window constancy for an unordered pair. Private.

defs.name: head_slot_min
defs.signature: private theorem head_slot_min {c : Chain} (hS : StrictSlots c) {G : Block} (hHead : blockAt? c 0 = some G) : ∀ B ∈ c, G.slot ≤ B.slot
defs.meaning: The head block has the minimum slot. Private.

defs.name: window_producer_inj'
defs.signature: private theorem window_producer_inj' {n u s s' : Nat} (hs : u ≤ s ∧ s < u + n) (hs' : u ≤ s' ∧ s' < u + n) (hp : producerForSlot n s = producerForSlot n s') : s = s'
defs.meaning: Producer↔slot injectivity within one n-window (Nat.ModEq form). Private; a same-named private copy also lives in KeyStealingScheduleBudget.lean:125 (`window_producer_inj`, Finset.mem_Ico form). Neither is importable.

theorems.name: lockstep_declares_rosterGen
hypotheses: {rosterGen : Nat → Nat} {Sig sk pk : Type} {ops : SigOps Sig sk pk} {registry : KeyRegistry pk} {rented : ByzantineSlots} {Stolen : Nat → Nat → Prop} {honestSigned : Nat → Nat → Option Block} {now Δ : Nat} {G : Block} {R T : Nat}
hP : LockstepPackage n rosterGen ops registry rented Stolen honestSigned now Δ G R T
hVal : validSignedChainLock n ops registry sc = true   (FULL chain, genesis-rooted)
hHead : blockAt? (stripSigs sc) 0 = some G   (genesis at position 0 — REQUIRED)
hRecent : ∃ t, (stripSigs sc).getLast? = some t ∧ now ≤ t.slot + Δ   (tip recency of the whole chain)
theorems.conclusion: ∀ W, ∀ B ∈ stripSigs sc, B.slot / n = W → (∃ D ∈ stripSigs sc, W * n + n ≤ D.slot + 1) → B.keyIndex = rosterGen W
theorems.notes: THE PINNING THEOREM. Matured-window witness is any chain block D with W*n + n ≤ D.slot + 1 (aligned window [W*n, W*n+n)). Proof: strong induction on W. Base W=0: head_slot_min from hHead puts G in window 0, lockstep_const gives B.keyIndex = G.keyIndex, then hP.genesis_gen (needs G.slot / n = 0). Step W ≥ 1: previous window is matured (witness B itself), density (hDense from validChainK_sound hVK).1 = MaturedWindowsDense) yields a block A there, IH pins A.keyIndex = rosterGen (W-1), chain monotonicity (lockstep_rel .2) gives hlow : rosterGen (W-1) ≤ B.keyIndex; by_contra: chainSlotsIn (stripSigs sc) (W*n) n ⊆ badSlotsIn rented (W*n) n ∪ (Finset.Ico (W*n) (W*n+n)).filter (theftSched n (lagSched n rosterGen) Stolen) — for each chain slot s, either rented, or Stolen (s%n) B.keyIndex (witness j := B.keyIndex, side-condition lagSched … s ≤ B.keyIndex from hlow), else hP.unforgeable.unforgeable (schedCore0_of_lock hVal) hsbmem hRecent hver hrent' hstol' gives honestSigned … = some sb.block and hP.declared forces B.keyIndex = rosterGen W, contradiction. Count: theft-filter card ≤ T via Set.InjOn (producerForSlot n) (window_producer_inj') + hP.exposedBound (W*n); rent ≤ R via hP.rentBound (W*n); quorum n ≤ windowCount = (chainSlotsIn …).card (chainSlotsIn_card hS) ≤ R + T ≤ maxByzantine n < quorum n (unfold maxByzantine quorum; omega). Package fields CONSUMED: genesis_gen, unforgeable, declared, exposedBound (at u = W*n, at lagSched), rentBound (at u = W*n), budget_le. NOT consumed: mono, hashInj. Needs the genesis (hHead) for the base case AND the full chain (hVal over all of sc; the EUF-CMA surface quantifies over whole-chain core validity + tip recency); cannot be applied to a suffix. Every theft slot in the window is at the SINGLE generation g = B.keyIndex, so the count would equally follow from an erasure_freeze-shaped bound at j := g (the D1'-full census) — the cumulative exposedBound is used only to match PackageA's shape.

hypotheses: {rosterGen : Nat → Nat} {Sig sk pk : Type} {ops : SigOps Sig sk pk} {registry : KeyRegistry pk} {rented : ByzantineSlots} {Stolen : Nat → Nat → Prop} {honestSigned : Nat → Nat → Option Block} {now Δ : Nat} {G : Block} {R T : Nat}

hVal : validSignedChainLock n ops registry sc = true
hRecent : ∃ t, (stripSigs sc).getLast? = some t ∧ now ≤ t.slot + Δ
theorems.conclusion: validSignedChainSched n (lagSched n rosterGen) ops registry sc = true
theorems.notes: THE TRANSPORT. sigsOk and validChainK are copied from hVal; schedPinned (lagSched n rosterGen) is proved blockwise: window 0 by constancy with G + genesis_gen; window W ≥ 1 by pinning the previous (always matured, witness B) window via lockstep_declares_rosterGen and chain monotonicity rosterGen (W-1) ≤ B.keyIndex. modules.purpose: Design note (H0) for free-cadence lockstep. Status header: D1'-thin IMPLEMENTED (Lean 8593455, paper 55b9709); D1'-full (per-generation census) REMAINS OPEN. Records the rule choice (D1 → D2 superseded → D1' recommended), the 2026-08-01 reduction audit with three obstructions (which found the factor-2 claim WRONG), the revised recommendation (D1'-thin vs D1'-full fork), and the H1–H5 phasing. 251 lines.

defs.name: badLock (design-level, not in Lean)
defs.signature: badLock n rented Stolen c s := rented s ∨ Stolen (producerForSlot n s) (genOf c s)
defs.meaning: The per-generation corruption predicate, chain-relative through genOf c s (the generation the chain declares at slot s). Not formalized anywhere; `genOf` is listed under H1 (line 228) but the landed module has no genOf.

defs.name: erasure_freeze reading (design)
defs.signature: ∀ j, ((Finset.range n).filter (fun i => Stolen i j)).card ≤ T   — uniform in the generation j
defs.meaning: The bound on badLock need not be chain-relative: whichever generation a chain is at, its per-window stolen census is ≤ T. 'Chain-relative predicate, chain-independent bound. That is the whole trick.' Corollary (line 42): this makes erasure_freeze load-bearing; today it is documentary (consumed by no proof; implied by exposedBound for full-window schedules via erasure_freeze_of_exposedBound).

defs.name: D1 — window-granular no-mixing
defs.signature: Rule: generation constant within each n-window, non-decreasing across windows. Safety: each window uses one generation's stolen keys (≤ T by erasure_freeze) + ≤ ρ rented. Wrinkle (line 67): two chains may sit at different generations in the same window, union census ρ + 2T; two ways out — (a) require ρ + 2T ≤ maxByzantine in the package (factor 2 in tolerated theft rate), or (b) prove a relaxed agreement engine needing only bad-count < quorum using quorum > 2·maxByzantine (holds for every n; verified in dconf-2n-tightness-finding). 'Start with the first; the second is a clean follow-up that recovers the rate.' Reuses deep_block_agreement_of_height_depth unchanged.
defs.meaning: First candidate rule; its factor-2 wrinkle SURVIVES the audit.

defs.name: D2 — quorum-gated advancement (superseded)
defs.signature: Gate redundant: validChain enforces quorum n ≤ windowCount c u n on every matured window (maturedWindowsDense, Definitions.lean:95; matured = u + n ≤ tip.slot + 1), and each producer owns one slot per window, so quorum blocks = quorum distinct producers, all one generation under D1. Full D2 rule kept for the record at line 180.
defs.meaning: George's objection 2026-07-31; density already supplies the backing.

defs.name: D1' — window-constancy + lockstep-honest behaviour (RECOMMENDED)
defs.signature: Validator = D1 without gate. B1 as behaviour: execution-level rosterGen : Nat → Nat, per window, monotone, every honest signature declares its window's rosterGen; discovered not fixed; client holds genesis + clock. Pinning lemma (line 119): any valid chain's matured windows declare exactly rosterGen (proof sketch = the landed lockstep_declares_rosterGen). Intended consequence (line 127): corruption predicate rented s ∨ Stolen (producerForSlot n s) (rosterGen (window s)) chain-independent so ρ + T ≤ maxByzantine suffices — 'but see the audit below'.
defs.meaning: The shape that landed; its selling point (no factor 2) was corrected by the audit.

defs.name: Audit result (2026-08-01): PARTIAL — the factor-2 claim above is WRONG
defs.signature: Transport half is free (all scheduled theorems are stated for arbitrary schedule : Nat → Nat, no monotonicity/periodicity). Pinning lemma sound; 'its counting really does run off erasure_freeze'; near-genesis not a hole (window [0,n) matured once tip.slot ≥ n−1, given by hLong). Obstruction 1 (line 150): schedPinned is whole-chain c.all, pinning reaches only matured windows; tip's aligned window never matured, lockstep monotonicity bounds it below only by previous window; fix = instantiate at the one-window-lagged schedule rosterGen ∘ (windowOf · − 1). Obstruction 2 (line 157): that fix kills the factor-2 saving — the agreement engine's pigeonhole always runs at the sliding window [tip.slot+1−n, tip.slot+1) (Safety.lean:97, KeyStealingScheduleHorizon:191) which straddles the un-pinned tip window, so the consulted census is again the ≥/cumulative one, erasure_freeze stays non-load-bearing, D1's factor-2 wrinkle is NOT removed; recovering the per-generation census requires generalizing horizon_shared_prefix to an arbitrary window, costing confirmation depth 2n instead of n. Obstruction 3 (line 166): EUF-CMA surface is contravariant in the validator, pinning needs it, so a lockstep-scoped surface is circular; fix = assume SchedCoreUnforgeable at a pointwise-smaller schedule (constant 0) — legitimate, full-to-core precedent — but then the crypto field is literally PackageA's. Net (line 173): H1–H4 collapse to ~one module + corollaries; resulting package is assumption-wise PackageA (cumulative exposedBound), not the per-generation-census package; the timed layer does not transport at all.
defs.meaning: What the audit found wrong and why erasure_freeze is still not load-bearing after D1'-thin.

defs.name: Recommendation (revised twice — post-audit)
defs.signature: D1'-thin (line 209): instantiate scheduled machinery at the lagged schedule; ~one module; PackageA's assumptions; does NOT make erasure_freeze load-bearing. D1'-full (line 214): additionally generalize horizon_shared_prefix to an arbitrary window so the pigeonhole runs inside a pinned region; earns the per-generation census, makes erasure_freeze carry weight, costs confirmation depth 2n rather than n plus real proof work. Either way the one new hypothesis is B1-as-behaviour (honest signatures declare their window's rosterGen), to be disclosed alongside A3/A0/B2.
defs.meaning: George's call; D1'-thin is what landed.

defs.name: Phasing H1–H5
defs.signature: H1: Model/KeyStealingLockstep.lean — genOf, validSignedChainLock, window-constancy and monotonicity lemmas, (D2 only) fork-pinning. H2: recency-scoped EUF-CMA surface for the lockstep validator (same shape as SchedUnforgeable/KeyStealingEUFCMA), honest-slot uniqueness, lockstep_recent_tip_ancestor_agreement and _mem. H3 (line 235): `PackageC` (or `LockstepPackage`): rentBound, erasure_freeze now load-bearing, budget_le, and the derived ByzantineBounded. H4: MoltPetit/Results/, every headline into Results/Axioms.lean. H5: paper changes (mode-3 body, Table 2 row, appendix census route promoted to machine-checked, B1 no-mixing leaves the unmodeled list, re-audit abstract).

modules.purpose: Scheduled budget decomposition and the two operational packages PackageA / PackageB (PackageB extends PackageA with erasure_freeze). Imported by the lockstep module; source of PackageA, exposedProducersSched, theftSched, erasure_freeze. 473 lines, namespace MoltPetit.Model, `open Classical`.

defs.name: theftSched
defs.signature: def theftSched (n : Nat) (schedule : Nat → Nat) (Stolen : Nat → Nat → Prop) (s : Nat) : Prop := ∃ j, schedule s ≤ j ∧ Stolen (producerForSlot n s) j
defs.meaning: Theft half of badSched: producer holds a stolen key of the scheduled-current-OR-LATER generation (cumulative ≥ reading).

defs.name: exposedProducersSched
defs.signature: noncomputable def exposedProducersSched (n : Nat) (schedule : Nat → Nat) (Stolen : Nat → Nat → Prop) (u : Nat) : Finset Nat := (Finset.Ico u (u + n)).filter (fun s => theftSched n schedule Stolen s) |>.image (producerForSlot n)
defs.meaning: Exposed producers of window [u, u+n) — the image under producerForSlot of the theft-corrupt slots.

defs.name: PackageA
defs.signature: structure PackageA (n : Nat) (schedule : Nat → Nat) {Sig sk pk : Type} (ops : SigOps Sig sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (rented : ByzantineSlots) (Stolen : Nat → Nat → Prop) (honestSigned : Nat → Nat → Option Block) (now Δ : Nat) (G : Block) (R T : Nat) : Prop where unforgeable : SchedCoreUnforgeable n schedule ops registry rented Stolen honestSigned now Δ; hashInj : SignedHashInjective (SignedDeclared n ops registry) G; rentBound : ∀ u, (badSlotsIn rented u n).card ≤ R; exposedBound : ∀ u, (exposedProducersSched n schedule Stolen u).card ≤ T; budget_le : R + T ≤ maxByzantine n
defs.meaning: Mode-2 package (fixed scheduled rotation, no erasure). LockstepPackage.toPackageA lands here at schedule := lagSched n rosterGen.

defs.name: PackageB
defs.signature: structure PackageB (n : Nat) (schedule : Nat → Nat) {Sig sk pk : Type} (ops …) (registry …) (rented …) (Stolen …) (honestSigned …) (now Δ : Nat) (G : Block) (R T : Nat) extends PackageA n schedule ops registry rented Stolen honestSigned now Δ G R T : Prop where erasure_freeze : ∀ j : Nat, ((Finset.range n).filter (fun i => Stolen i j)).card ≤ T
defs.meaning: erasure_freeze (line 337) = per-generation frozen census: for every generation j at most T producers ever have their generation-j key stolen. Docstring (313-330): 'consumed by no proof'; implied by exposedBound for full-window schedules; the genuinely-B discharge needs the unmodeled B1 no-mixing rule.

theorems.name: induced_byzantine_bounded_sched

modules.purpose: Core model vocabulary the lockstep module uses (all in namespace MoltPetit.Model).

defs.name: quorum
defs.signature: def quorum (n : Nat) : Nat := (2 * n + 2) / 3

defs.name: maxByzantine
defs.signature: def maxByzantine (n : Nat) : Nat := (n - 1) / 3
defs.meaning: ⌊(n-1)/3⌋; maxByzantine n < quorum n is discharged inline by `unfold maxByzantine quorum; omega`.

defs.name: producerForSlot
defs.signature: def producerForSlot (n slot : Nat) : Nat := slot % n
defs.meaning: Round-robin producer.

defs.name: Block
defs.signature: structure Block where slot : Nat; height : Nat; prev : Option Nat; id : Nat; contentsHash : Nat; keyIndex : Nat deriving Repr, DecidableEq
defs.meaning: keyIndex = declared delegate-key version (the 'generation' in mode 3).

defs.name: Chain
defs.signature: abbrev Chain := List Block
defs.meaning: Lowest height first.

defs.name: blockInWindow
defs.signature: def blockInWindow (u len : Nat) (b : Block) : Bool := decide (u ≤ b.slot ∧ b.slot < u + len)

defs.name: windowCount
defs.signature: def windowCount (c : Chain) (u len : Nat) : Nat := (c.filter (blockInWindow u len)).length

defs.name: maturedWindowsDense
defs.signature: def maturedWindowsDense (n : Nat) (c : Chain) (t : Nat) : Bool := (List.range (t + 2 - n)).all fun u => windowDense n c u
defs.meaning: Bool density check; matured means u + n ≤ t + 1.

defs.name: SigOps
defs.signature: structure SigOps (σ sk pk : Type) where sign : sk → Block → σ; verify : pk → Block → σ → Bool

defs.name: KeyRegistry
defs.signature: abbrev KeyRegistry (pk : Type) := Nat → Nat → pk
defs.meaning: registry i j = participant i's delegate key at version j.

defs.name: SignedBlock
defs.signature: structure SignedBlock (σ : Type) where block : Block; sig : σ

defs.name: SignedChain
defs.signature: abbrev SignedChain (σ : Type) := List (SignedBlock σ)

defs.name: stripSigs
defs.signature: def stripSigs {σ : Type} (sc : SignedChain σ) : Chain := sc.map SignedBlock.block
defs.meaning: B ∈ stripSigs sc unpacks via List.mem_map.mp to ⟨sb, sb ∈ sc, sb.block = B⟩.

defs.name: sigOk
defs.signature: def sigOk {σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (ops : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (sb : SignedBlock σ) : Bool := ops.verify (registry (producerForSlot n sb.block.slot) sb.block.keyIndex) sb.block sb.sig
defs.meaning: Verify at the DECLARED version.

defs.name: sigsOk
defs.signature: def sigsOk {σ sk pk : Type} (n : Nat) (ops : SigOps σ sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (sc : SignedChain σ) : Bool := sc.all (sigOk n ops registry)

defs.name: ByzantineSlots
defs.signature: abbrev ByzantineSlots := Nat → Prop

defs.name: blockAt?
defs.signature: def blockAt? (c : Chain) (h : Nat) : Option Block := getElem? c h
defs.meaning: List indexing by height.

defs.name: StrictSlots
defs.signature: def StrictSlots (c : Chain) : Prop := c.Pairwise fun a b => a.slot < b.slot

defs.name: MaturedWindowsDense
defs.signature: def MaturedWindowsDense (n : Nat) (c : Chain) : Prop := ∀ ⦃m⦄ ⦃D : Block⦄, blockAt? c m = some D → ∀ u, u + n ≤ D.slot + 1 → quorum n ≤ windowCount c u n
defs.meaning: Semantic density; the pinning proof applies it as hDense hkD (W * n) (by omega).

defs.name: ValidChain
defs.signature: def ValidChain (n : Nat) (c : Chain) : Prop := SequentialHeights c ∧ StrictSlots c ∧ ParentLinked c ∧ MaturedWindowsDense n c
defs.meaning: Destructured as ⟨hSeq, hS, hPL, hDense⟩.

defs.name: badSlotsIn
defs.signature: noncomputable def badSlotsIn (bad : ByzantineSlots) (u n : Nat) : Finset Nat := (Finset.Ico u (u + n)).filter fun s => bad s
defs.meaning: open Classical in.

defs.name: ByzantineBounded
defs.signature: def ByzantineBounded (n : Nat) (bad : ByzantineSlots) : Prop := ∀ u, (badSlotsIn bad u n).card ≤ maxByzantine n
defs.meaning: Molt.FaultBounded = this by rfl.

defs.name: chainSlotsIn
defs.signature: def chainSlotsIn (c : Chain) (u len : Nat) : Finset Nat := ((c.filter (blockInWindow u len)).map Block.slot).toFinset

defs.name: SigningLog
defs.signature: abbrev SigningLog := Nat → Nat → Option Block
defs.meaning: Molt's name for honestSigned's type.

defs.name: SignedHashInjective
defs.signature: def SignedHashInjective (Signed : Block → Prop) (G : Block) : Prop := ∀ ⦃B B' : Block⦄, (B = G ∨ Signed B) → (B' = G ∨ Signed B') → B.id = B'.id → B = B'
defs.meaning: Collision resistance on the genesis-or-Signed domain.
